segments.text: Phil buys Luke a new bike because he wants to show Claire that their son can be responsible. Claire is sure Luke will lose it, and soon after, Phil sees what looks like Luke’s bike lying outside without a lock.
segments.tts_text: [a natural conversational storyteller] Phil buys Luke a new bike because he wants to show Claire that their son can be responsible. Claire is sure Luke will lose it, and soon after, Phil sees what looks like Luke’s bike lying outside without a lock.

segments.text: Phil decides to teach Luke a lesson, so he takes the bike and hides it. But while he’s helping their new neighbor, Desiree, get into her locked house, the bike disappears. Phil panics and buys another one before Claire finds out.

segments.text: When he gets home, he realizes Luke’s real bike has been there the whole time. He took another child’s bike by mistake. Claire finds out, and instead of admitting everything, Phil makes up an even bigger story about how the bike disappeared.

segments.text: Unfortunately, Desiree arrives with the missing bike and explains that a neighbor moved it into her garage while Phil was helping her. His story falls apart.

segments.text: Meanwhile, Gloria asks Jay and Manny to install a ceiling fan together. She hopes spending some time together will help them get closer.

segments.text: It doesn’t go well. Jay refuses to read the instructions, while Manny keeps talking about his biological father, Javier, and how exciting and fearless he is. Jay gets annoyed because he knows Javier often lets Manny down.

segments.text: After a fan blade hits Manny, they start arguing. Manny accuses Jay of not wanting him around, and Jay angrily says that, right at that moment, he doesn’t. Manny says he wishes Jay had never married Gloria, and Jay fires back that the situation isn’t exactly easy for him either.

segments.text: Later, Manny waits outside because Javier is supposed to take him to Disneyland. Javier calls Jay and says he isn’t coming because he’s busy gambling. Jay is furious, but he doesn’t want Manny to know the truth.

segments.text: Mitchell and Cameron also take Lily to a baby class for the first time. Mitchell worries that the other parents will judge them, so he asks Cameron to dress and act less dramatically.

segments.text: Once the class begins, Mitchell becomes nervous because the other babies seem to be developing faster than Lily. Cameron, however, just wants them to enjoy the experience. Mitchell eventually realizes that he’s putting too much pressure on everyone and lets Cameron be himself.

segments.text: By the end, all three fathers have made mistakes. But they keep trying, and they keep spending time with their children. As Jay stays beside Manny, the caring and protective side of him starts to come out naturally.
